records.company_overview: Postman is the leading collaboration platform for API-development, used by more than 40 million users and 500,000 companies worldwide. Postman simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so you can create better APIs—faster.
records.target_audience: Engineers, developers, and teams building and managing APIs at all scales.

records.company_overview: Supabase is an open‑source Firebase alternative that provides a Postgres database, authentication, storage, real‑time, and edge functions, all managed through a single dashboard. It offers a fully managed, scalable platform with built‑in Row Level Security and instant REST APIs for rapid application development.
records.target_audience: Developers building web and mobile applications, startups, and enterprises looking for a scalable, open‑source backend.
